changeSet.author: saeb
changeSet.createView: SELECT t.BUYER_NAME, t.BUYER_NATIONAL_CODE, t.BUYER_CODE FROM TBL_IME_TRADE t WHERE t.BUYER_NATIONAL_CODE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY t.BUYER_NAME, t.BUYER_NATIONAL_CODE, t.BUYER_CODE

changeSet.author: saeb
changeSet.createView: SELECT tt.BUYER_CODE, tt.BUYER_NATIONAL_CODE, tt.BUYER_NAME FROM (SELECT max(t.ID) id FROM TBL_IME_TRADE t WHERE t.BUYER_NATIONAL_CODE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY t.BUYER_NATIONAL_CODE) t LEFT JOIN TBL_IME_TRADE tt ON t.id = tt.id

changeSet.author: saeb
changeSet.createView: SELECT trade."ID", trade."BROKER_BUY_WAGE", trade."BROKER_SELL_WAGE", trade."BUYER_BROKER_CODE", trade."BUYER_NAME", trade."BUYER_NATIONAL_CODE", trade."COMMODITY_CODE", trade."CONTRACT_DATE", trade."CONTRACT_DETAIL_NO", trade."CONTRACT_NO", trade."CONTRACT_TYPE_CODE", trade."CURRENCY_CODE", trade."DELIVERY_DATE", trade."DELIVERY_PLACE_DESC", trade."IME_BUY_WAGE", trade."IME_SELL_WAGE", trade."IS_CANCELED", trade."IS_DELAY_PENALTY", trade."LISTING_FEE", trade."MANFACTURER_NAME", trade."MEASURE_UNIT_CODE", trade."OFFER_CODE", trade."PAYMENT_CODE", trade."SELLER_BROKER_CODE", trade."SEO_BUY_WAGE", trade."SEO_SELL_WAGE", trade."SETTLEMENT_DATE", trade."SETTLEMENT_DEADLINE", trade."SETTLEMENT_TYPE", trade."SUPPLIER_CODE", trade."TOTAL_PRICE", trade."UNIT_COUNT", trade."UNIT_PRICE", trade."D_CREATED_DATE", trade."D_LAST_MODIFIED_DATE", trade."C_CREATED_BY", trade."C_LAST_MODIFIED_BY", trade."CLOB_OPTIONS", trade."RESPONSE_DATE", trade."MESSAGE_TEXT", trade."comment", trade."DESCRIPTION" FROM (SELECT t.CONTRACT_NO, t.CONTRACT_DETAIL_NO, max(t.D_CREATED_DATE) D_CREATED_DATE FROM TBL_IME_TRADE_SETTLEMENT t GROUP BY t.CONTRACT_NO, t.CONTRACT_DETAIL_NO) tt LEFT JOIN TBL_IME_TRADE_SETTLEMENT trade ON tt.D_CREATED_DATE = trade.D_CREATED_DATE AND tt.CONTRACT_NO = trade.CONTRACT_NO AND tt.CONTRACT_DETAIL_NO = trade.CONTRACT_DETAIL_NO
